articles.title: Protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution to solve scaling bottlenecks
articles.snippet: CTDG Dev Hub participant’s protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution, allowing network nodes to reach agreement on blocks before transaction execution completes.

articles.title: DGrid AI token jumps 93% after launch as decentralized AI network goes live
articles.snippet: DGAI nearly doubled in its first day of trading as DGrid expands its distributed AI inference network and rolls out hardware for its personal AI agent.

articles.title: Shipyard winds down IPFS work after Protocol Labs ends funding
articles.snippet: The funding loss leaves InterPlanetary File System software without dedicated maintainers and puts the future of key public services in Protocol Labs’ hands.

articles.title: Revolut Launches Euro-Pegged EURR Stablecoin
articles.snippet: EURR has gone live for selected customers in Denmark, Poland and Portugal, with a Luxembourg subsidiary of Stripe holding the reserves.

articles.title: Hugging Face Explores $13 Billion Sale a Month After a Rogue OpenAI Agent Hacked It
articles.snippet: The open-source AI hub is fielding buyout interest at nearly triple its 2023 valuation, weeks after a security breach and days after Stripe's OpenRouter deal reset the price of AI infrastructure.
